annotations.text:
MAXIMALIST RESTYLE — a deliberate break from the old soft-card look.
Fonts: Anton (display, ultra-condensed, uppercase) + Space Grotesk (interface) + Space Mono (all data, tabular). Grotesque skeleton shared, width and rhythm contrasted; Grotesk and Mono are companion designs.
Colour: brand orange #F97316 plus two accents rotated in hue at identical lightness and chroma — oklch(0.70 0.19 h) at h46 / h350 / h145 — so orange, auction-magenta and open-green carry equal weight. Flat fills, no tinted-outline pills.
Surfaces: 6px radii (was 24px), 1.5px borders, grain + hairline + hazard-stripe texture, oversized ghosted Anton type bleeding off frame edges, orange nav bar instead of a floating dark pill.

PAGE 1 ENDPOINTS
Home  GET /tournament?sport&city&status
Tournament  GET /tournament/:id · GET /tournaments/:id/categories · GET /tournaments/:id/teams
Category & entry  GET /categories/:id · GET /sports/:sport (format+scoring from SportConfig) · POST /registrations/register
Checkout  POST /payments/create-order · POST /payments/verify
Payment status  GET /payments/status/:orderId

BADMINTON — fully served by the backend, so every stage is covered.
Live match  GET /sports/badminton/match/:id + socket. THE GAP: badminton live scoring is fully built server-side (POST /sports/badminton/match/:id/live/start and /live/point) but src/app/live/[matchId].tsx returns UnsupportedSport for anything that is not cricket. This artboard is that missing screen — games table, serve indicator, point-by-point feed.
Knockout draw  GET /sports/badminton/match/by-category/:categoryId (rounds derived from match round field)
Team league  GET /sports/badminton/team-league/:categoryId/overview · /groups · /standings · /groups/:groupId/ties · /ties/:tieId · /ties/:tieId/lineup
Category standings  GET /matches/leaderboard/:categoryId (the sport-agnostic one)
Auction broadcast  GET /auction/:tournamentId/:categoryId/status · /sold-log + socket. Sport-agnostic — this same screen serves cricket.

CRICKET — three of these are corrections to the previous canvas, which had the API shapes wrong.
Live match  GET /sports/cricket/match/:id · /:id/live · /:id/scorecard + socket
Ball by ball  GET /sports/cricket/stats/matches/:matchId/innings/:inningsNumber/balls — an endpoint that exists and had no screen at all. Innings switch, over headers, per-ball rows.
Category charts  GET /sports/cricket/stats/categories/:categoryId/leaderboard?sort=runs|wickets|sr|economy|fours|sixes|highest — SEVEN sort keys, not the Batting/Bowling/Fielding tabs drawn before. One chip per key; the table columns follow the active sort.
My tournament stats  GET /sports/cricket/stats/registrations/:registrationId/stats?tournamentId=… — per REGISTRATION, not per player, so it is scoped to one tournament.
Also live: POST /sports/cricket/stats/matches/:matchId/rebuild-stats, but that is organizer-only and gets no player screen.

THE PLAYER'S OWN SURFACES — everything player-facing the API serves.
Profile  GET /player/auth/profile · /stats · PATCH /profile · PUT /profile-image
My registrations  GET /registrations/my-registrations · POST /registrations/:id/withdraw — covers all four states: auctioned into a team, approved and awaiting auction, unpaid with a held slot, and past.
Team detail  GET /teams/:id · GET /registrations/teams/:teamId/roster
Public player profile  GET /player/auth/public/:playerId — no screen existed for this
Announcements  GET /tournaments/:tournamentId/announcements — no screen existed for this
Settings  POST /player/auth/change-password · POST + DELETE /player/auth/fcm-token · POST /contact · GET /sports/:sport
Not drawn, deliberately: tournament history and invoices already have working screens that this restyle does not change; say the word and I will bring them across too.

BUILD THIS FIRST.
State patterns is the highest-value artboard on the canvas: every screen currently blanks itself to a centred spinner. Fixing it once here beats fixing it twenty times later.
Type, colour & components carries the full restyle — the three fonts with their roles, the hue-rotated accent trio, tags, chips, controls, nav and the four atmosphere devices. Nothing on the other twenty artboards uses anything that is not on this sheet.

SPORT SCOPE: home filters to badminton and cricket only. src/lib/tournamentConstants.ts currently offers bowling, basketball and volleyball, none of which SportConfig supports — those filters can only ever return empty.

ONBOARDING & AUTH — all 12 of these screens are still on the old Oswald/Montserrat styling; these eight artboards bring them across.
Flow: Welcome -> Story (3 beats) -> Card preview -> Name & photo -> Register -> Verify code -> Card issued. Sign in is the side entrance from Welcome.
The player ID card is the payoff of the whole flow, so it is designed twice: PREVIEW (locked, no photo, player number pending) and ISSUED (photo, real number, brand border, glow). Do not water either down — this is the moment the product earns the account.
NOT DRAWN, deliberately: Set password is Change password on page 7 minus the current-password field. Forgot password is Sign in with only the email field. Creating and Entering are transitions — use Skeleton + Ghost from Patterns rather than a spinner.
Endpoints  POST /player/auth/register · /verify-otp · /set-password · /resend-otp · /login · /login/otp · /login/otp/verify · /forgot-password

ACCOUNT — the four screens behind Profile.
Edit profile  PATCH /player/auth/profile · PUT /player/auth/profile-image. The form is long; it scrolls under a pinned save bar. Gender is a hard three-way segment, not a dropdown.
Change password  POST /player/auth/change-password. Strength is four hard blocks, not a rounded bar; the rules list shows what is still missing rather than only failing on submit.
Payments  GET /payments/my-payments · GET /payments/status/:orderId. Total-paid is a slab at the top, not a footer total. Failed rows sort first and carry the retry — they are the only actionable ones.
Tournament history  GET /player/auth/tournament-history. Grouped by year, with the per-sport stat row switching between badminton (record) and cricket (runs/wickets).
ALREADY BUILT: profile/settings.tsx, profile/history.tsx and profile/registrations.tsx are migrated already — history here replaces the improvised version. profile/edit.tsx and profile/invoices.tsx are still stale.
